Card Q&A.a: No. Even if you have multiple Digimon with [Sistermon] in their names in play, you can only use this Digimon’s effect to delete 1 of your opponent’s Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: If I have 2 Digimon with [Sistermon] in their names in play, can I use this card’s effect to delete 2 of my opponent’s Digimon with 5000 DP or less?

Inherited Effect: [When Attacking][Once Per Turn] If you have a Digimon with [Sistermon] in its name in play, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 5000 DP or less.
